gameInstructions: Use the flooded ground to stop every iron chariot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sisera brought his nine hundred iron chariots to the Kishon River, certain that strength would decide the day.

lines.speaker: deborah
lines.text: Go! This is the day the Lord has given Sisera into your hands.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Barak swept down from Tabor. The storm broke, the river rose, and the heavy chariots foundered in mud.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The river Kishon swept them away—the age-old river, the river Kishon.

gameSuccess: The chariots are caught in the flooded ground—the advantage is broken.
name: Ch.4 · The Storm
